description: Inspired by Akaza, the fearsome Upper Rank Three. Features striking blue markings and crimson-inspired details. Brings his martial arts legacy to the truck's design. A fierce presence that commands attention on the road.

Inspired by Satoru Gojo, the strongest sorcerer or the modern era. A striking design reflecting his limitless power. Brings his iconic presence to the truck. A true symbol of absolute superiority on the road.
A fiery PHONEHIX-inspired theme featuring blazing flames and a bold, dark aesthetic.
A bold FC Barcelona-inspired design celebrating the club's iconic Blaugrana colours, featuring a striking blend of blue and red for a true Culers identity.

Forged in darkness, awakened by lightning. Electric violet meets unstoppable blue fury. Chrome armor. Neon veins. Pure domination. Not built to follow the road, built to own it. HYPERION X: THE FUTURE HAS ARRIVED.
